wet

Stream discharge for BC’s Freshwater Atlas: monthly and seasonal flow per segment, historical and climate-scenario, from modelled runoff and hydrometric stations

Chinook flow at two stations works through the station path on real data: a map of the stations and their catchments, the last five years against 1981–2010 in the open-water Chinook windows, the daily hydrograph, departure since 1981, and trends.
